_comment: How the Ludus server invokes Packer for a template build. Derived from buildVMFromTemplateWithPacker() in ludus-api/api_template_management.go and the 'Creating Your Own Templates' section of docs/docs/using-ludus/templates.md. Regenerate with `make update-reference`.
working_directory: the directory that contains the template's .pkr.hcl file (relative paths in the template resolve from here)

cli_variables.name: proxmox_host
cli_variables.description: Proxmox node name to build on (server config proxmox_node)

cli_variables.name: proxmox_skip_tls_verify
cli_variables.description: Whether to accept the Proxmox API certificate without verification (server config proxmox_invalid_cert)

cli_variables.name: proxmox_pool
cli_variables.description: Always SHARED: templates must live in the SHARED pool to be usable by every Ludus user

cli_variables.name: proxmox_storage_pool
cli_variables.description: VM disk storage pool (server config proxmox_vm_storage_pool)

cli_variables.name: proxmox_storage_format
cli_variables.description: VM disk format for the storage pool (server config proxmox_vm_storage_format)

cli_variables.name: iso_storage_pool
cli_variables.description: Storage pool ISOs are downloaded to (server config proxmox_iso_storage_pool)

cli_variables.name: ansible_home
cli_variables.description: Writable ANSIBLE_HOME for the building user; everything outside the install dir is read-only

cli_variables.name: ludus_nat_interface
cli_variables.description: Bridge templates are built on (server config ludus_nat_interface)

environment_variables.name: proxmox_password
environment_variables.description: Declared by the documented required block; Ludus sets it to an empty string so the Proxmox plugin falls back to the PROXMOX_TOKEN environment variable. Must be sensitive and never have a default.

environment_variables.name: proxmox_username
environment_variables.description: Declared by the documented required block; Ludus sets it to an empty string so the Proxmox plugin falls back to the PROXMOX_USERNAME environment variable (the user's API token id). Never give it a default.

process_environment.PACKER_PLUGIN_PATH: /opt/ludus/resources/packer/plugins (plugins are pre-installed; templates must not rely on `packer init`)
process_environment.PROXMOX_USERNAME: <user API token id> (read by the Proxmox plugin when `username` is empty)
process_environment.PROXMOX_TOKEN: <user API token secret> (read by the Proxmox plugin when `password`/`token` are empty)
process_environment.ANSIBLE_ROLES_PATH: user roles dir, then the instance-wide global roles dir (inherited by Ansible provisioners; do not override)
process_environment.ANSIBLE_COLLECTIONS_PATH: user collections dir, then the instance-wide global collections dir (inherited by Ansible provisioners; do not override)
